term.label: consensus

definition.text: A sequence produced from an aligment algorithm that uses multiple sequences as input.

comments: Term added Dec 06 to comply with mapping to MGED terms. It should be used to generate consensus regions. The specific cross product terms they require are consensus_region and consensus_mRNA.
